title: The Morning Digest: October 11, 2026
dek: Saturday brought blockade enforcement from both sides: the US disabled the Panama-flagged M/V Ocean Molica in the Gulf of Oman for running the Iran blockade, and UKMTO logged a second tanker strike, at 19:20 UTC in the Strait of Hormuz. Hurricane Isaias is finished as a storm story: landfall near Destin late Friday at 105 mph per wire reports, major refineries spared, about 830,000 customers without power, and the focus now on the restart watch. Markets are closed until 16:00 MDT Sunday; Friday settles stand at WTI Nov26 $91.85 and Brent Dec26 $104.72. The diesel deal's paper is getting picked apart: GL-135 names no volumes or buyers and does not repeal the 2022 statutory ban, Moscow's own export ban runs through October, and Kyiv says it will keep striking Russian refineries. ICE (Oct 9): TMW Nov26 -$24.78, Dec26 -$25.60 still the widest tenor. The SPR exchange award is still pending.
